references.text: Listen of the sons of Simeon when Jacob and his family went to Egypt. Here are mentioned Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Sohar, and Saul.
Another list of the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Sohar, and Saul. These were the clans of Simeon.
The first census of the tribe of Simeon in the wilderness, where the men of the tribe were counted.
The placement of the tribe of Simeon in the camp and their leader Selumiel son of Zuriel.
The book of Chronicles gives a parallel genealogy for the sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Serach, and Saul.
